vikisozluk_etimolojiler.metin: From Ge'ez ግልባብ (gəlbab, “covering, veil, wrapper”) from ገልበበ (gälbäbä, “to cover, to veil, to wrap, to envelop”), whereas the verbs in the Arabic root ج ل ب ب (j l b b) are denominal.
See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
